answer: A fresh key is bare as quartz: no sealed grading history for peers to read. Weight accrues only from quorum-matched verdicts a key seals one epoch at a time, each re-checked on-ledger against consensus, so counterfeiting a record is as hopeless as faking the slow dissolution that hollows a karst. A falcon-eyed panel re-grades sampled seals, so standing cannot be bought or handed over. M clones each repay M times the honest judgment labor; the sybil bill is linear in identities, never shared.
